frozen_note: Frozen before any held-out (test split) outcome was inspected. Validation pilots (seeds 2000-2019) were used to set caps and check feasibility; test streams 3000-3099 are opened only by tools/bench.py suites.
candidate_ordering: dense valid-geometry list in increasing candidate_id = 10*rotation + x; ties to the lower id
software_engine: python-fast column-bitmask model, validated against the literal-descent reference (tests/unit/test_policy.py, test_lookahead.py) and against RTL differential corpora (results/decisions/)

depth.note: predeclared smaller workload; compare only within this paired study

statistics.resampling_unit: stream id, jointly across compared policies

tournament.note: actual RTL replays through the native Verilator driver, checked against Python at every move

expectations_from_validation_pilot.note: exact-policy games reached the 500-piece validation cap on 20/20 streams (about 196 lines); the 2,000-piece cap is therefore expected to censor most exact-policy games, and cap-hit fraction plus lines-at-cap are the primary statistics
